name: HELLHOUND WB

specs.notes: 6.2 supercharged Hemi V8 (6,166 cc): 717 hp (535 kW) SAE net at 6,000 rpm, 889 N m at 4,800; curb weight 2,029 kg (automatic; 2,017 manual); TorqueFlite 8HP90 4.71/3.14/2.10/1.67/1.29/1.00/0.84/0.67, final 2.62 (the Tremec 6-speed manual: 2.26/1.58/1.19/1.00/0.77/0.63, final 3.70); 57/43; Cd 0.398, 305/35ZR20. Top speed 314 km/h is Dodge's figure for the 2018 707-hp Widebody (none published for 2022). Frontal area 2.35 m2 is an estimate.

garage.blurb: The supercharged muscle hero: 717 hp of blown V8 through the rear tyres, widebody arches, two tonnes. A missile in a straight line, a handful in the bends: feed it the throttle gently.

interior.notes: Simple but complete: dash, steering wheel, seats (low-poly); the seller's high-poly interior grafted onto the low-poly exterior. An automatic: the hand stays on the wheel.

limitations: The interior is low-poly (the seats especially).
